meta.scope: offline static analysis; no module loaded, no radio contacted
meta.method: printable-string harvest from every SHT_PROGBITS section of umac.ko and ath_dev.ko (WA, XC, XW), then exact-literal lookup of each knob name and its last dotted component
meta.claim_limit: a string match is a NECESSARY condition, not proof of effect: a driver can carry a command name and still no-op it, and a knob can be implemented without its catalogue name appearing as a literal. effect_on_registers is therefore UNKNOWN for every knob.

gaps: a string match does not prove the handler executes or that it writes a register
effect_on_registers is UNKNOWN for all 571: proving MAC/BB/PCU effect needs the handler body traced into register writes, which this stage does not do
names are matched as exact literals; a knob whose catalogue spelling differs from the driver string (case, underscore, abbreviation) is counted absent
no dynamic validation: no module loaded, no radio contacted
